title: Repro Overview
description: Everything this repo does while it runs, in one place. Generated by tools/gen-overview-dashboard.py.

panels.title: At a glance: is it running, how is it configured, is anything breaking?

options.content:
```
k6 / console ─▶ transactions-api ×4
                │ OTLP every 10s
                ▼   (metrics + spans)
            Alloy (agent pool)
        remote_write │      │ OTLP
                ▼    │      ▼
        Prometheus ◀─┘    Tempo
                 ╲      ╱
                  Grafana
```
**Start a run:** the [load-test console](http://localhost:8080) (needs `make ui`) or `make load`.

**Drill in:** [Cardinality Repro](/d/cardinality-repro) · [Deep Dive](/d/cardinality-deep-dive) · [Trace Correlation](/d/trace-correlation) · [Traces Drilldown](/a/grafana-exploretraces-app/explore) · [Explore](/explore)

Red markers on graphs = container restarts; orange = `response_time` label switched.

panels.title: Offered load (k6)
panels.description: Requests/s k6 sent (make load). The console's own load isn't in Prometheus: see Transactions / s.

panels.title: Transactions / s recorded
panels.description: What the app recorded, as it arrives through Alloy (about 20 s behind).

panels.title: Server p95
panels.description: From the bounded duration histogram.

panels.title: Client failures (k6)
panels.description: Share of k6 requests that failed or timed out.

panels.title: App replicas available
panels.description: Of 4. Below 4 means a replica is restarting or failing its readiness probe.

panels.title: Restarts (last 1h)
panels.description: App, Alloy, Prometheus, Grafana and Tempo containers. Details in the Cluster section.

panels.title: http_transactions_total series
panels.description: Bounded is about 32k with 200 pod names, under 1k with VIRTUAL_PODS=1.

panels.title: Alloy refused points / s
panels.description: memory_limiter pushing back: those exports fail and the app retries them.

panels.title: OTLP export failures / s
panels.description: Exports the app's SDK didn't deliver. Over 64 MiB they're dropped before sending, and the pod goes dark in Prometheus.

panels.title: response_time label
panels.description: CARDINALITY_MODE / console label switch.

panels.title: Pod names per replica
panels.description: VIRTUAL_PODS: 1 = production-like (make prod-pods), 50 = the L1–L5 setting (make lab-pods).

panels.title: SDK cardinality limit
panels.description: OTEL_CARDINALITY_LIMIT. The SDK default is 2000; scope 'all' pre-allocates about 4 KiB heap per unit (run-A sweep).

panels.title: Tag allow-list (F1)
panels.description: make fix-app / unfix-app.

panels.title: Tracing
panels.description: Configured trace sampling, live (console or make traces-on RATIO=…). Hard cap 75%. Exemplars ride on the metrics while it's on.

panels.title: Agent profile
panels.description: From Alloy's memory limit: 384 MiB = make agent-constrained, 1 GiB = make agent-normal.

panels.title: 1 · Load and latency: is the app degrading?
Response time (diamonds = sampled requests: hover → View trace)
panels.description: Server side: http_transaction_duration_seconds (via Alloy). Client side: k6 (make load only).

panels.title: Failures
panels.description: Business outcomes (declined/failed) are HTTP 200; these are overload failures only.

panels.title: 2 · App replicas: what the SDK's state costs the pod
CPU throttling per pod
panels.description: Share of CFS periods throttled. Bounded runs: about 9–13% mean at 80% load (noise floor about 3 points).

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="demo", container="app"}[1m])) / sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="demo", container="app"}[1m]))

panels.title: .NET GC heap per pod
panels.description: Heap after the last GC (all generations). High-cardinality SDK state shows up here: about 40 MiB bounded, 480 MiB at 200k series.

panels.title: GC pause time per pod
panels.description: Seconds paused per second.

panels.title: App restarts
panels.description: Liveness kills show here without OOMKilled (the run-A 200k failure mode).

panels.title: 3 · Cardinality: the core of the test
Appended labels
panels.description: APPENDED_LABELS (make appended-labels N=…)

panels.title: Duration histogram series
panels.description: Bounded by design: the right home for response time. Exemplars don't change this count.

panels.title: 4 · OTLP export: app → Alloy (measured inside the app)
Export duration per replica
panels.description: Serialize + send + retries. Dashed line: the 8 s export timeout.

panels.title: Bytes per export
panels.description: Dashed line: 64 MiB, where OTel .NET drops the export before sending (MaxRequestSizeBytes).

panels.title: OTLP metric points received / s
panels.description: Includes the simulated fleet when it's on.

panels.title: CPU vs limit
panels.description: No limit line = no CPU limit (normal profile).

panels.title: 6 · Prometheus (1 GiB limit: the OOM trigger)
7 · Traces and exemplars (make tracing + make traces-on)
Spans / s through the pipeline
panels.description: About 3 spans per sampled transaction.

panels.title: Exemplars (trace ids on samples)
panels.description: One fixed ring buffer for all series: exemplars never add series.

panels.title: Trace sampling: configured vs observed (cap 75%)
panels.description: Observed = transactions whose trace was sampled ÷ all transactions, counted in the app (2-min window, shown above 20 tx/s). The cap bounds the probability, so a short window can read a little above the ratio: at 300 tx/s and 75% it stayed within 74–77%.

panels.title: Slowest recent sampled transactions (click a Trace ID; more in Trace Correlation)

targets.query: {resource.service.name="transactions-api" && kind=server && duration >= 50ms} | select(span.transaction.state, span.transaction.product, span.transaction.consume_type, resource.service.instance.id)

panels.title: 8 · Simulated fleet (make fleet-on: 2 × 150 pods on the fleet node)
Fleet replicas
panels.description: Each replica simulates 150 pods, each with its own OTLP export to Alloy.

panels.title: Alloy inbound load vs the app's own
panels.description: The difference is the fleet. The protect profiles drop the fleet's series before Prometheus, so they appear only here.

targets.legendFormat: real replicas' points/s (points per export / 10 s)

panels.title: Node memory used / capacity
panels.description: Docker Desktop VM: 8 GB for all nodes together.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD"}) / on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource="memory"})

panels.title: Node CPU used (cores)
panels.description: App nodes are capped at 4 CPUs (make node-cpus), the agent and fleet nodes at 2.
